t: A free laser cutting course guide for STEM, CTE, and creative programs, sent after a form.
steps: Find the laser cutting syllabus page on the CAD Dimensions website.
Use a school or work email address to fill out the form.
Download the syllabus from the link.
Check that your laser cutter and room setup meet the safety needs.
Adapt the syllabus to your students.
Ask IT to approve the design software.
